GAP.name: Yang Wood (Jia/Gap)
GAP.description: The spirit of a giant tree reaching straight toward the heavens, symbolizing unbending ambition.

EUL.name: Yin Wood (Yi/Eul)
EUL.description: It holds the wisdom of a vine that adapts to any terrain and flourishes through flexibility.

BYEONG.name: Yang Fire (Bing/Byeong)
BYEONG.description: The impartial light of the sun, illuminating every corner of the world without discrimination.

JEONG.name: Yin Fire (Ding/Jeong)
JEONG.description: A focused flame, like a candle or starlight, guiding lost souls through the darkness.

MU.name: Yang Earth (Wu/Mu)
MU.description: The majestic form of a mountain that observes history with unwavering stillness.

GI.name: Yin Earth (Ji/Gi)
GI.description: The energy of fertile soil that accepts all seeds and brings them to fruition.

GYEONG.name: Yang Metal (Geng/Gyeong)
GYEONG.description: An unrefined gemstone or heavy blade that enforces necessary change.

SIN.name: Yin Metal (Xin/Sin)
SIN.description: A well-crafted jewel, sharp and beautiful, demanding a delicate touch.

IM.name: Yang Water (Ren/Im)
IM.description: A deep sea holding the secrets of life and infinite possibilities.

GYE.name: Yin Water (Gui/Gye)
GYE.description: The form of mist and light rain that gently permeates the world to nurture life.
